description: SLICE/SHANK code cave (v1, sidespin only). Hooks the spin builder after omega write; adds sidespin to omega.y proportional to the horizontal miss (azimuth-facing), which already scales with (1-ability) via the miss magnitude. K_SIDE=0.01 tunable. Cave in .xcode int3 padding (executable, no section change). Deploy on loose-realism-v2. Restore reverts.
